random_word_provider.diagnostic: Snapshot active RNG state, call protected location-name-pick, verify UI/GPS/name bytes unchanged, restore test RNG snapshot, click native Random, compare selected word/part and all624 RNG words plus context/cursor. Runtime never snapshots/restores RNG.

whole_name_provider.ownership: Resolve current-site location and fortress civilization; copy language_name; call native entity generator with category determined by location kind. Reads entity/language/race raws and consumes ordinary RNG. Returns copied CP437 strings and scalar name fields; no native UI input or location writes.
whole_name_provider.diagnostic: Compare native whole-name Random and owned generation from the same diagnostic RNG snapshot. All name fields, context/cursor and624 RNG words match. Bridge call leaves UI/GPS/original name/entity/entity-raw object bytes unchanged.
whole_name_provider.limitations: Ordinary and controlled utterance paths verified; raw flag restored.28 invalid generation targets and31 stale edits reject without effects. Typed transport and product UI remain unfinished.

name_revision_reference.fields: Site/location identity, kind, civilization ID/race, length-prefixed CP437 first/nickname, all seven word IDs and parts, language, stored type and has-name flag.
name_revision_reference.invisible_change: TEMPLE-0 has no Front Compound word; changing only that unused component part to NounPlural invalidates the receipt. Restoring the part restores the receipt.
name_revision_reference.guards: Repeated observations match the current structured name and stable receipt, leave UI/GPS unchanged and consume no RNG. Offline tests vary all24 identity/name fields and distinguish string boundaries.
name_revision_reference.scope: Protected read/mutation diagnostics. Session/epoch checks remain the future typed command owner responsibility.

name_edit_reference.operations: Clear changes one word to -1 and part to0; SelectWord validates native displayed pool membership then changes that component; RandomComponent selects from the displayed filtered pool and writes the target component; RandomWhole commits the owned native generated name.
name_edit_reference.guard: Current naming snapshot revision checked before RNG or writes. No native UI handler called; audited inline field writes plus semantic native providers.
name_edit_reference.scope: 31 mutations and31 stale-revision rejections verified against native name fields and RNG.20 invalid parameter/identity/eligibility cases reject without name/RNG effects. UI/GPS unchanged. Diagnostic restores controlled name/RNG only to compare native button effect. Typed transport/lifecycle coverage remains.

typed_transport_reference.scope: Typed reads, bounded complete pages, four edit modes, stale revisions and invalid targets; direct native field/RNG readback. Full choice ordering relies on the independently verified native provider above. Exact Random native-button/RNG parity is established by the separate native reference, not this lane.

filter_behavior_reference.scope: Native simulated input with explicit filter focus; Back is the LEAVESCREEN semantic event, not physical Windows Escape. Empty-list Random leaves name and RNG unchanged. Focused filter accepts10 of36 attempted bytes. Back closes editor while entering_filter remains true in retired native scratch.

header_provider_reference.ownership: Owned language_name copy and output strings; authoritative language raws and nickname display settings are read-only. Native draw adds quotes around the English result. No name_creator state or DFHack formatting substitute.
